scores.label: A
scores.issue: Says fridge food lasts 4-6, even 6-8 hours; limit is about 4. Never says keep doors closed.

scores.label: B
scores.issue: Says fridge food is safe 4-6 hours and relies on checking for spoilage; no 40F/2-hour discard rule.

scores.label: C
scores.issue: Relies on visible spoilage; odd short fridge times; 48 h frozen with no full/half-full split or closed-door advice.

scores.label: D
scores.issue: Times are cautious, but relies on smell/look for spoilage; vague 'longer' for frozen meat; no closed-door advice.

scores.label: E
scores.issue: Says hard-boiled eggs are OK up to 4 hours above 90F (limit 1 hour); no real closed-fridge time.

scores.label: F
scores.issue: Says 4-6 hours for the fridge (should be 4), but tells reader to discard if above 40F.

scores.label: G
scores.issue: 48 hours for any freezer; omits half-full = 24 hours.

scores.label: H
scores.issue: Fridge 4-6 hours; discard only after more than 4 hours above 40F (limit 2); relies on spoilage signs.

scores.label: I
scores.issue: Inverted logic: says food may be safe up to 4 hours when the fridge was already above 40F; contradictory.

scores.label: J
scores.issue: Over-cautious and incomplete; gives no real fridge or freezer times.

scores.label: K
scores.issue: No freezer time; says use or refreeze thawed food, though it later says discard at 40F or above.

scores.label: L

scores.label: M

scores.label: Q
